task_title: Cloud-parallel AI combo x hill-climb eval pipeline

plan_review.notes: Adversarial review REJECTED the config-by-seed matrix + top-K-on-defaults design; all 12 concerns (8 blocking) adopted. Major fork: (1) SSOT win comparator officialWin=victory AND gameTimeMs<6min, slack maxFrames; (2) multi-column leaderboard not single scalar winner, composite score headline + win-count/flips/time/xp/gold, flag divergence for human at S5; (3) real holdout seeds 81-100 touched once at validate; (4) all 8 combos get a tuned pass, no default pruning, LEGACY tuned control; (5,6) matrix over COMBO (8 jobs) with in-process coordinate-ascent + worker-pool, kills 256-cap risk and cross-run handoff; (7) knob spec from real SSOT not stale hill-climb ranges; (8) carry forward zero win-loss-flip / no-regression veto columns; (10,11) provenance + aggregate recompute-from-rows with dedup/missing/mismatch rejection; (12) dispatch-only trigger, drop sweep push token. Alternatives 1 in-process orchestrator, 2 combo-only matrix, 3 all-combos coarse + halving — blended all three.

rounds.notes: 1 (BLOCKING, gpt-5.4 + claude-sonnet-4.6): aggregator trusted row.officialWin/row.score -> shared deriveRunFacts(ScorableStats, budgetMs) used by BOTH producer runOne AND verifier assertRowsConsistent + isWin recompute in buildLeaderboard. 2 (BLOCKING, gpt-5.4): mixed-provenance shards -> mergeShards throws on stage/runnerOs/nodeVersion/packageLockHash/workflowSha mismatch. 3 (BLOCKING, gpt-5.4): NaN CLI ints hang the pool -> strict parsePositiveInt/parseNonNegativeInt on --workers/--rounds. 4 (HIGH, gemini): runOne downgraded ALL non-wins to timeout -> narrowed to over-budget victory only. 5 (NON-BLOCKING, claude-sonnet-4.6): configId collision silent overwrite -> mergeShards throws on conflicting definition.

Confirmation round on the fixed diff. Both models confirmed all 5 round-1 fixes correct and independently CLEARED the flagged highest-risk item (strict === on score after a JSON round-trip is safe: V8 serializes doubles with shortest-round-trip precision and scoreRun is pure over exactly the stored fields). gemini: fully clean, no issues. gpt-5.4: 1 new HIGH -> parseNonNegativeInt/parseSeeds coerced blank/whitespace segments to seed 0 (e.g. 1,,3), letting a malformed workflow_dispatch seed input silently skew the panel.
